Select quarantine simulation scenarios

select_scenarios.Rd

Selects scenarios for specified reproduction numbers and a minimum vaccine efficacy. Results are ordered by reproduction number and vaccine efficacy.

Usage

select_scenarios(data, r0_values = 1:10, min_efficacy = 0)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the numeric columns `r0`, `vaccine_efficacy` and `relative_pressure`.

r0_values

A numeric vector of reproduction numbers to retain. Defaults to all published values from 1 to 10.

min_efficacy

A single number between 0 and 0.9. Scenarios with vaccine efficacy equal to or above this value are retained. Defaults to 0.

Value

A data frame containing the selected scenarios. Returns zero rows when no scenarios match.

Examples

select_scenarios(
  quarantine_scenarios,
  r0_values = c(3, 6),
  min_efficacy = 0.5
)
#>    r0 vaccine_efficacy relative_pressure
#> 1   3              0.5        0.29183561
#> 2   3              0.6        0.22369157
#> 3   3              0.7        0.12244568
#> 4   3              0.8        0.10566475
#> 5   3              0.9        0.03570799
#> 6   6              0.5        1.00990948
#> 7   6              0.6        0.74000431
#> 8   6              0.7        0.29838987
#> 9   6              0.8        0.24983511
#> 10  6              0.9        0.08162687
